verses.original: Συνεργοῦντες δὲ καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν μὴ εἰς κενὸν τὴν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ δέξασθαι ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Synergountes de kai parakaloumen mē eis kenon tēn charin tou Theou dexasthai hymas
verses.literal: As God’s fellow workers then we urge you not to receive God’s grace in vain

verses.original: λέγει γάρ Καιρῷ δεκτῷ ἐπήκουσά σου καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ σωτηρίας ἐβοήθησά σοι Ἰδοὺ νῦν καιρὸς εὐπρόσδεκτος ἰδοὺ νῦν ἡμέρα σωτηρίας
verses.transliteration: legei gar Kairō dektō epēkousa sou kai en hēmera sōtērias eboēthēsa soi Idou nyn kairos euprosdektos idou nyn hēmera sōtērias
verses.literal: For He says In the time of favor I heard you and in the day of salvation I helped you Behold now is the time of favor now is the day of salvation

verses.original: Μηδεμίαν ἐν μηδενὶ διδόντες προσκοπήν ἵνα μὴ μωμηθῇ ἡ διακονία
verses.transliteration: Mēdemian en mēdeni didontes proskopēn hina mē mōmēthē hē diakonia
verses.literal: We put no obstacle in anyone’s way so that no one can discredit our ministry

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ἐν παντὶ συνιστάνοντες ἑαυτοὺς ὡς Θεοῦ διάκονοι ἐν ὑπομονῇ πολλῇ ἐν θλίψεσιν ἐν ἀνάγκαις ἐν στενοχωρίαις
verses.transliteration: all’ en panti synistanontes heautous hōs Theou diakonoi en hypomonē pollē en thlipsesin en anankais en stenochōriais
verses.literal: Rather as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way in great endurance in troubles hardships and calamities

verses.original: ἐν πληγαῖς ἐν φυλακαῖς ἐν ἀκαταστασίαις ἐν κόποις ἐν ἀγρυπνίαις ἐν νηστείαις
verses.transliteration: en plēgais en phylakais en akatastasiais en kopois en agrypniais en nēsteiais
verses.literal: in beatings imprisonments and riots in labor sleepless nights and hunger

verses.original: ἐν ἁγνότητι ἐν γνώσει ἐν μακροθυμίᾳ ἐν χρηστότητι ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ ἐν ἀγάπῃ ἀνυποκρίτῳ
verses.transliteration: en hagnotēti en gnōsei en makrothymia en chrēstotēti en Pneumati Hagiō en agapē anypokritō
verses.literal: in purity knowledge patience and kindness in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love

verses.original: ἐν λόγῳ ἀληθείας ἐν δυνάμει Θεοῦ διὰ τῶν ὅπλων τῆς δικαιοσύνης τῶν δεξιῶν καὶ ἀριστερῶν
verses.transliteration: en logō alētheias en dynamei Theou dia tōn hoplōn tēs dikaiosynēs tōn dexiōn kai aristerōn
verses.literal: in truthful speech and in the power of God with the weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left

verses.original: διὰ δόξης καὶ ἀτιμίας διὰ δυσφημίας καὶ εὐφημίας ὡς πλάνοι καὶ ἀληθεῖς
verses.transliteration: dia doxēs kai atimias dia dysphēmias kai euphēmias hōs planoi kai alētheis
verses.literal: through glory and dishonor slander and praise viewed as imposters yet genuine

verses.original: ὡς ἀγνοούμενοι καὶ ἐπιγινωσκόμενοι ὡς ἀποθνήσκοντες καὶ ἰδοὺ ζῶμεν ὡς παιδευόμενοι καὶ μὴ θανατούμενοι
verses.transliteration: hōs agnooumenoi kai epiginōskomenoi hōs apothnēskontes kai idou zōmen hōs paideuomenoi kai mē thanatoumenoi
verses.literal: unknown yet well-known dying and yet we live on punished yet not killed

verses.original: ὡς λυπούμενοι ἀεὶ δὲ χαίροντες ὡς πτωχοὶ πολλοὺς δὲ πλουτίζοντες ὡς μηδὲν ἔχοντες καὶ πάντα κατέχοντες
verses.transliteration: hōs lypoumenoi aei de chairontes hōs ptōchoi pollous de ploutizontes hōs mēden echontes kai panta katechontes
verses.literal: sorrowful yet always rejoicing poor yet making many rich having nothing and yet possessing everything

verses.original: Τὸ στόμα ἡμῶν ἀνέῳγεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς Κορίνθιοι ἡ καρδία ἡμῶν πεπλάτυνται
verses.transliteration: To stoma hēmōn aneōgen pros hymas Korinthioi hē kardia hēmōn peplatyntai
verses.literal: We have spoken freely to you Corinthians Our hearts are open wide

verses.original: οὐ στενοχωρεῖσθε ἐν ἡμῖν στενοχωρεῖσθε δὲ ἐν τοῖς σπλάγχνοις ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: ou stenochōreisthe en hēmin stenochōreisthe de en tois splanchnois hymōn
verses.literal: It is not our affection but yours that is restrained

verses.original: τὴν δὲ αὐτὴν ἀντιμισθίαν ὡς τέκνοις λέγω πλατύνθητε καὶ ὑμεῖς
verses.transliteration: tēn de autēn antimisthian hōs teknois legō platynthēte kai hymeis
verses.literal: As a fair exchange I speak as to my children open wide your hearts also

verses.original: Μὴ γίνεσθε ἑτεροζυγοῦντες ἀπίστοις τίς γὰρ μετοχὴ δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀνομίᾳ ἢ τίς κοινωνία φωτὶ πρὸς σκότος
verses.transliteration: Mē ginesthe heterozygountes apistois tis gar metochē dikaiosynē kai anomia ē tis koinōnia phōti pros skotos
verses.literal: Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers For what partnership can righteousness have with wickedness Or what fellowship does light have with darkness

verses.original: τίς δὲ συμφώνησις Χριστοῦ πρὸς Βελιάρ ἢ τίς μερὶς πιστῷ μετὰ ἀπίστου
verses.transliteration: tis de symphōnēsis Christou pros Belial ē tis meris pistō meta apistou
verses.literal: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever

verses.original: τίς δὲ συνκατάθεσις ναῷ Θεοῦ μετὰ εἰδώλων ἡμεῖς γὰρ ναὸς Θεοῦ ἐσμεν ζῶντος καθὼς εἶπεν ὁ Θεὸς ὅτι Ἐνοικήσω ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐμπεριπατήσω καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτῶν Θεός καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μου λαός
verses.transliteration: tis de synkatathesis naō Theou meta eidōlōn hēmeis gar naos Theou esmen zōntos kathōs eipen ho Theos hoti Enoikēsō en autois kai emperipatēsō kai esomai autōn Theos kai autoi esontai mou laos
verses.literal: What agreement can exist between the temple of God and idols For we are the temple of the living God As God has said I will dwell with them and walk among them and I will be their God and they will be My people

verses.original: Διὸ ἐξέλθατε ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν καὶ ἀφορίσθητε λέγει Κύριος καὶ ἀκαθάρτου μὴ ἅπτεσθε κἀγὼ εἰσδέξομαι ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Dio exelthate ek mesou autōn kai aphoristhēte legei Kyrios kai akathartou mē haptesthe kagō eisdexomai hymas
verses.literal: Therefore come out from . . . among them and be separate says the Lord Touch no unclean thing and I will receive you

verses.original: Καὶ Ἔσομαι ὑμῖν εἰς Πατέρα καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔσεσθέ μοι εἰς υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας λέγει Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ
verses.transliteration: Kai Esomai hymin eis Patera kai hymeis esesthe moi eis huious kai thygateras legei Kyrios Pantokratōr
verses.literal: And I will be a Father to you and you will be My sons and daughters says the Lord Almighty
